title: MoE-Lightning: High-Throughput MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPUs
authors: Shiyi Cao; Shu Liu; Tyler Griggs; Peter Schafhalter; Xiaoxuan Liu; Ying Sheng; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Matei Zaharia; Ion Stoica
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, KV cache offloading, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Efficient batch inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained GPUs (e.g. Mixtral 8x7B on a single 16 GB T4) is bottlenecked by CPU-GPU I/O of expert weights and KV cache; existing offloading systems such as FlexGen and DeepSpeed Zero-Inference under-utilize CPU memory, CPU compute, and CPU-GPU bandwidth simultaneously, and rely on a flat roofline that cannot capture the hierarchical memory and bandwidth structure of CPU+GPU systems.
problem_statement.zh: 在記憶體受限的 GPU（例如單張 16 GB T4）上對 Mixtral 8x7B 等大型 MoE 模型進行批次推理時，效能瓶頸在於 expert 權重與 KV cache 的 CPU-GPU I/O；FlexGen 與 DeepSpeed Zero-Inference 等既有 offloading 系統無法同時充分利用 CPU 記憶體、CPU 運算與 CPU-GPU 頻寬，且其依賴的單層 roofline 模型無法刻畫 CPU 加 GPU 系統的階層式記憶體與頻寬結構。

key_innovation.en: Two co-designed components: (1) CGOPipe, a fine-grained CPU-GPU-I/O pipeline schedule with weights paging that interleaves QKV download, hidden upload, weights transfer, and KV cache transfer to overlap with CPU attention and GPU MoE FFN computation; and (2) the Hierarchical Roofline Model (HRM), an extension of the classical roofline to multi-level memory hierarchies (GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, CPU-GPU PCIe) that introduces per-level compute roofs, intra-level memory roofs, and cross-level memory roofs, exposing turning points and a balance point that guide the search for optimal batch size N, micro-batch size mu, device placement of attention and MoE FFN, and the fraction of weights stored on GPU.
key_innovation.zh: 兩個共同設計的元件：(1) CGOPipe，一種帶 weights paging 的細粒度 CPU-GPU-I/O pipeline schedule，將 QKV download、hidden upload、weights transfer 與 KV cache transfer 交錯安排，使其與 CPU attention 及 GPU MoE FFN 計算重疊；(2) Hierarchical Roofline Model（HRM），把傳統 roofline 擴展至多層記憶體階層（GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、CPU-GPU PCIe），引入各層 compute roof、層內 memory roof 與跨層 memory roof，揭露 turning point 與 balance point，藉以搜尋最佳批次大小 N、micro-batch 大小 mu、attention 與 MoE FFN 的放置裝置，以及 GPU 上靜態保留權重的比例。

key_improvements.en: Up to 10.3x higher generation throughput (without prompt padding) and 3.5x (with padding) over FlexGen on a single T4 GPU for Mixtral 8x7B (S1); up to 6.7x over FlexGen, FlexGen(c), and DeepSpeed (S2). Mixtral 8x22B and DBRX on 2-4 T4 GPUs reach 2.1-2.8x improvement, and super-linear scaling is observed from 2 to 4 T4 GPUs under tensor parallelism.
key_improvements.zh: 在單張 T4 GPU 上對 Mixtral 8x7B 的生成吞吐（S1）較 FlexGen 提升最多 10.3x（無 prompt padding）及 3.5x（含 padding）；在 S2 設定下相較 FlexGen、FlexGen(c) 與 DeepSpeed 提升最多 6.7x。Mixtral 8x22B 與 DBRX 於 2 至 4 張 T4 GPU 上達 2.1 至 2.8x 提升，且在 tensor parallelism 下從 2 GPU 擴展至 4 GPU 呈現超線性 scaling。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA T4 (16 GB), NVIDIA L4 (24 GB), Intel Xeon CPU, DDR4

scope_assumptions.en: Decode-phase optimization only (prefill assumed compute-bound and offload-irrelevant); single-node, intra-node tensor parallelism only (no pipeline parallelism across nodes); no disk offloading considered; HRM assumes theoretically calculated FLOPs and bytes with profiled peak hardware bandwidth, acknowledged to deviate from real kernel performance; KV cache modeled at single-precision (float32 in figures, float16/int4 explored only for attention).
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅針對 decode 階段最佳化（prefill 視為 compute-bound 而不考慮 offload）；僅探討單節點內 tensor parallelism，不考慮跨節點 pipeline parallelism；不考慮 disk offload；HRM 採用理論 FLOPs 與 bytes 搭配實測峰值頻寬，作者明確指出與實際 kernel 表現可能存在差異；KV cache 主要以單精度建模（圖示使用 float32，僅在 attention 上探討 float16 與 int4）。
